title: Health Page Theme And Path Hide
description:
The theming of this page makes the values look more like the labels/headers. Screenshot reference: Screenshot 2026-05-25 103010.png (local account path omitted from repo task content; attach or copy a sanitized asset before PR).

I also don't want the paths hidden in the health page. This can be an admin only page if we're that worried

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented the Health feedback by showing runtime/storage-related paths directly on /health again and styling runtime configuration values as distinct code-like value chips instead of plain label-like strong text. Profile/Admin sensitive-value masking remains unchanged. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed after stopping the expected apphost lock; browser probe confirmed full Data and Pages paths are visible with no reveal/copy buttons in the Health config grid and value styles use bordered code-like rendering; route-smoke passed 6/6 against http://127.0.0.1:5099.
